race.comment: SHADOW DANE (6) was responsible for a solid effort last time out when third at Dubbo over 1420m, beaten only 0.7 lengths. That was on a heavy deck there and he is a winner in heavy going previously. Trending the right way now and can make his presence felt. MACLEAY (7) improved sharply last time out to score by 7 lengths over 2000m at Louth two weeks ago. High on confidence now and has solid top-three prospects. The well-related PRINCE OF SORTS (2) (half to G3 winner and G1 placed Arbeitsam) next in line from the inside alley. REBEL'S EDGE (9) won't find the heavy going a hinderance and boasts a sound third-up record. Keep safe.
